problem_statement: Since the warehouse client was upgraded to 2.0 (`migrator/warehouse.py`), every migration job fails with `AttributeError: 'WarehouseExecutor' object has no attribute 'execute'`. The 2.0 client removed the string-based `execute(sql)` in favour of `apply(DdlStatement)`, which returns a `DdlResult`. Please migrate the handlers in `migrator/target_runner.py` to the new API, following the port the warehouse team left in `reference/target_runner.py`. Drops whose target no longer exists should come back with status `noop` instead of `applied`.

After upgrading the warehouse client to 2.0 (`migrator/warehouse.py`), all migration jobs are failing with `AttributeError: 'WarehouseExecutor' object has no attribute 'execute'`. In 2.0 the string-based `execute(sql)` was removed and replaced by `apply(DdlStatement)`, which returns a `DdlResult`. Please port the handlers in `migrator/target_runner.py` to this new API, using the port the warehouse team left in `reference/target_runner.py` as a guide. When a drop's target no longer exists, it should return status `noop` rather than `applied`.
